video_title: Why I Re-Enrolled at UCLA After Making the NBA | UCLA Basketball Tour!!

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on his degree plan and future career goals
quotes.excerpt: At this point it's more so just getting the paper than a specific degree.
quotes.quote: I'm meeting with my guy Ruben, we're going to go over my degree plan and everything to see what major I can get out of school fastest with. At this point it's more so just getting the paper than a specific degree, just so if I want to go into broadcasting or whatever, I have the necessary requirements to be able to get a job for the position.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark reflects on his past parking ticket expenses at UCLA
quotes.excerpt: I probably had like $2,000 worth of parking tickets.
quotes.quote: I never pay for parking. This may sound actually insane, but I probably had like $2,000 worth of parking tickets during my time at UCLA. It was actually insane. I'm about to roll the dice again. I'm not paying for that parking ticket. They're going to have to get me in blood.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on his timeline for graduating from UCLA
quotes.excerpt: I'm a year away from graduating, but since I can only take summer classes, I'm on track.
quotes.quote: I'm a year away from graduating, but since I can only take summer classes, realistically because of the season, I'm on track to graduate when I'm 27. I'll be unk at the damn graduation. I'll be unk.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the impact of NIL on current college players
quotes.excerpt: Seeing these players come in now, playing for money, money, because they got NIL and everything.
quotes.quote: Seeing these players come in now, playing for money, money, because they got NIL and everything, it really is a different time. Real nostalgic at the same time.
